values.note: Booked on the park's own ResNexus engine or by phone; 2027 bookings open January 2, 2027. Deposit 25% of the stay or $100, whichever is greater. RV and tent sites: 72 hours' notice to cancel, less a $10 fee. From June 15 to August 30 stays are limited to 21 days in total without management's permission; tent sites CR 1-4 take at most one week.

note: Family-owned campground on Helena Flats Road northeast of Kalispell, with RV and tent sites and cabins; playground, fenced dog park and a swimming/fishing dock on the grounds. Repurposed school buses and horse trailers with living quarters are not allowed. --Claude
summary: Operator site + ResNexus: confirmed reservable (booking engine is the park's own ResNexus, platform operator) and the Good Sam/military discounts (10% on stays of 6 nights or less, now manual). Added full hookups (water/sewer; amperage not stated), pull-through sites, showers/laundry/store/dump/WiFi, the deposit/cancellation terms and the 21-day summer limit. Not stated: rates (2027 booking opens Jan 2, 2027; ResNexus shows only cabins now), season, amperage, site count, rig length. Note: RV Life/Good Sam/ResNexus restatements dropped.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator's rules say 'SWIMMING: At your own risk. NO lifeguard on duty' and 'FISHING: Allowed from the shore and dock, please be mindful of swimmers', and a review quoted on the home page mentions 'a real swimming hole'; the entry is 'not waterfront'. Probably a pond or creek on the grounds - check the satellite view.
